## Known biases

Point estimates only, not areal (the volume says they are not directly applicable to larger areas and an areal reduction factor is needed); estimates assume a stationary climate (historical data); the confidence bounds are 90% intervals and are not symmetric. A reading of intensities against the 1-hour row is for one point and one duration only. Licence text was not found (see licence fact).
